full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman J: The plaintiff-petitioner filed Other Suit No. 27 of 1986 for specific performance of contract. The suit was decreed by the Subordinate Judge, First Court, Chittagong on 31-12-1988. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree defendant No. 1 preferred First Appeal No. 201 of 1991 (Dhaka) before the High Court Division. A Division Bench of the High Court Division by its judgment and decree on 22-11-94 allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved by the judgment of the High Court Division the plaintiff-petitioner is seeking leave to appeal before us. 

 6. Mr. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed, learned Advocate appearing for the plaintiff-petitioner, submits first, that the learned Judges of the High Court Division acted wrongly in disbelieving the agreement and the payment of consideration money and wrongly set aside the judgment and decree of the trial Court and dismissed the suit. He next contends that the learned Judges of the High Court Division acted wrongly in becoming too technical on the question of pleading and ignoring the evidences adduced by the parties for merely non-pleading the date of execution of the agreement, Ext. 5 correctly.
